segments.an8.77:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an8.77:1.3: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.an8.77:2.1: [a. ni.8.61]“Aṭṭhime, āvuso, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an8.77:2.3: Idhāvuso, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
segments.an8.77:2.5: Tassa uṭṭhahato, ghaṭato, vāyamato lābhāya lābho nuppajjati.
segments.an8.77:2.6: So tena alābhena socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
segments.an8.77:2.7: Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso,‘bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, uṭṭhahati, ghaṭati, vāyamati lābhāya, na ca lābhī, socī ca paridevī ca, cuto ca saddhammā’”.

segments.an8.77:3.3: Tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho uppajjati.
segments.an8.77:3.4: So tena lābhena majjati pamajjati pamādamāpajjati.
segments.an8.77:3.5: Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso,‘bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati lābhāya, lābhī ca, madī ca pamādī ca, cuto ca saddhammā’”.

segments.an8.77:4.4: So tena alābhena socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.

segments.an8.77:9.6: Ime kho, āvuso, aṭṭha puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.

lines: So mamassa antarāyoti so mama jīvitantarāyopi, puthujjanakālakiriyaṃ karontassa saggantarāyopi maggantarāyopi assa.
Satthakā vā me vātāti satthaṃ viya aṅgamaṅgāni kantantīti satthakā.
Dasame kucchitaṃ sīdatīti kusīto da-kārassa ta-kāraṃ katvā.
Yassa dhammassa vasena puggalo “kusīto”ti vuccati, so kusitabhāvo idha kusita-saddena vutto.
Vināpi hi bhāvajotanasaddaṃ bhāvattho viññāyati yathā “paṭassa sukkan”ti, tasmā kusītabhāvavatthūnīti attho.
Taṃ pana caṅkamanavasena karaṇe kāyikantipi vattabbataṃ labhatīti āha “duvidhampī”ti.
Māsehi ācitaṃ nicitaṃ viyāti māsācitaṃ, taṃ maññe.
Yasmā māsā tintā visesena garukā honti, tasmā “yathā tintamāso”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Imināva nayenāti iminā kusītavatthūsu vutteneva nayena “duvidhampi vīriyaṃ ārabhatī”tiādinā.
Idaṃ paṭhamanti “idaṃ, handāhaṃ, vīriyaṃ ārabhāmī”ti,“evaṃ bhāvanāya abbhussahanaṃ paṭhamaṃ ārambhavatthū”tiādinā ca attho veditabbo.
Yathā tathā paṭhamaṃ pavattaṃ abbhussahanañhi upari vīriyārambhassa kāraṇaṃ hoti.
Anurūpapaccavekkhaṇasahitāni hi abbhussahanāni tammūlakāni vā paccavekkhaṇāni aṭṭha ārambhavatthūnīti veditabbāni.
